requires.degrade: Without node the SessionStart hook does not start, so numpy and onnxruntime are never installed and /speech:narrate stops. /speech:check still runs.
Without Python 3.12 or later the SessionStart hook cannot install numpy and onnxruntime, and /speech:narrate stops before it synthesizes anything.

Without espeak-ng the kokoro backend cannot turn the script into phonemes, so /speech:narrate stops before it writes narration.wav. espeak-ng is GPL-3.0: you install it, and this plugin never installs or ships it.

install.winget: eSpeak-NG.eSpeak-NG (espeak-ng.exe must then be on PATH)
